title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
plot_overview: A young airbender learns of an ancient power that could help save his culture from extinction. Joined by friends, he sets out on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens a hard-won peace.
will_you_like_this: You’ll likely enjoy the vivid animation, action, and return to a familiar world, especially if you’re a fan of Avatar: The Last Airbender; not for you if you want a slow, deeply developed story.
review_summary: Pros: striking animation; exciting action; familiar world | Cons: rushed story; predictable plot; friends feel underused
